interpretation.two_parts: Two separate assets: human and garment. Four sewing panels may then be cut from the garment: front, back, left sleeve, right sleeve.
interpretation.unzip: Cut explicitly declared sewing paths and flatten panels at real scale; not merely generate a texture UV atlas.

current_evidence_boundary.body: Synthetic, uncalibrated. Bone shoulder point is available; anatomical acromion and axillary folds are not independently measured.
current_evidence_boundary.cloth: Preassembled synthetic 3D rest mesh. Existing sewn/shared-vertex topology is not evidence of a manufactured flat pattern.
current_evidence_boundary.material: Unmeasured. Area density alone does not determine directional stretch, bending, shear, recovery or contact response.
current_evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: Independent assets, traceable panel cutting, flat-metric distortion, seam compatibility, and explicitly scoped numerical diagnostics.
not_allowed_claims: Natural human armhole has been measured
UV unwrapping establishes a manufacturable pattern
Uncalibrated simulation establishes comfort or physical fit

independent_body_target.definition: The body has no literal sleeve hole. Define a design-dependent arm-root reference region and a moving upper-arm/axilla envelope independently of the garment.
independent_body_target.persistence: Bind actual landmarks to the evaluated body mesh with triangle IDs and barycentric coordinates or equivalent deforming attachment, body/source hashes and pose/frame. Never retain unrelated world coordinates after body motion.
independent_body_target.synthetic_proxy_policy: Bone points and local mesh sections may be reported as proxies only; they cannot become anatomical ground truth by renaming them.
design_intent_required: required motions and allowed hem/shoulder displacement

gates.claim: Human and garment are independently loadable assets
checks: Human file has no garment object or garment cache
Garment file has no human mesh or linked human dependency
Units/world frame/body-pose contract explicit
Source vertex/triangle identity or declared remapping preserved with hashes
Standalone reload is tested rather than inferred from save success

gates.claim: Four scale-correct flattened sewing panels exist
checks: Use undeformed rest mesh, not stretched raised-arm simulation frame
Every source triangle belongs to exactly one declared panel; only cut-boundary vertices may duplicate
Each intended panel is a connected disk; each sleeve has an explicit underarm longitudinal cut
No flipped or degenerate2D triangles; no unintended panel self-overlap
Persist per-panel2D-to3D triangle/vertex mapping
Measure edge-length, area and angular distortion; report full distribution and maxima
Output stitch lines, seam IDs/notches, front/back labels, grain assumption, scale bar and seam-allowance status
Keep atlas packing transforms separate from metric coordinates
gates.threshold_policy: No universal flattening-distortion percentage is asserted. Compare measured distortion against declared project numerical budget and measured fabric capacity; missing capacity produces UNKNOWN for manufacturability.

gates.claim: Panels are compatible with the declared sewing design
checks: Compare stitch-line arc lengths, not seam-allowance cut edges
Define monotonic seam pairing and reversal explicitly
Measure front and back armhole segments separately against the appropriate sleeve-cap segments
Preserve notch-to-notch local arc-length correspondence
Declare cap ease distribution rather than silently imposing equal total lengths
Check sleeve underarm seam and bodice shoulder/side seams
Verify front/back and left/right labels against actual geometry and body pose
gates.threshold_policy: The target ease curve is a design input. Total cap length equality is necessary only for a specifically zero-ease design and is never sufficient for fit. Inherited2mm seam-closure limit is a numerical assembly check, not an armhole-fit standard.

gates.claim: Actual Cloth response uses the2D pattern rest metric from a source3D initial placement
checks: Rest-shape key is the intended flattened2D data with correct remapped vertex count
Shape-key display value remains0 so initial visible3D positions are unchanged
Independently recompute rest edge lengths and initial3D-to2D strain
Reset scene/cache for each trial and preserve source and settings hashes
A deliberate left-sleeve rest-metric perturbation causes a mechanically consistent measurable response
Rigid2D atlas transforms, with grain basis co-transformed when relevant, do not change intrinsic metric or trajectory
Confirm loose stitch edges operate as sewing constraints and do not inherit arbitrary atlas separation as structural rest length
gates.interpretation: This is an intervention on rest metric, not reconstruction from initially flat panels, automatic dressing, or fit approval.

gates.claim: The garment is geometrically worn by this evaluated body for specified saved poses
checks: Valid oriented body and garment topology
Incident and nonincident true self-intersections checked without blanket shared-vertex exclusion
Actual cloth/body crossings and containment checked
Current internal arm path ranges are tied to the actual body and skeleton, not independent supplied coordinates
Correct side and through-cuff topology with no fabric-wall passage
Cap/spanning-surface construction is independently valid; cap-dependent verdicts remain UNKNOWN
gates.limits: Saved-pose checks do not establish collision freedom during every solver substep or actual donning.

gates.claim: The numerical garment meets declared functional-fit goals within calibrated model limits
required_inputs: measured dimensions or explicit synthetic dimensions
warp/weft/bias material response, bending/shear, thickness, density and recovery as relevant
declared functional motions and design-dependent acceptance ranges
checks: Arm abduction and forward flexion, across-chest reach, elbow flexion and return motions, with trajectories rather than only final frames
Regional warp/weft strain and shear relative to2D material axes and validated material curves
Sleeve/armhole migration and hem rise against declared movement allowances
Body contact pressure separated from in-plane fabric stress
Numerical resolution/timestep sensitivity and repeatability
No missing metadata represented as a zero measurement
gates.missing_input_rule: UNKNOWN / BLOCKED; do not invent universal ease, pressure or strain thresholds.

gates.claim: The garment meets the real wearer’s fit and comfort goals
checks: Measured wearer and actual material
Printed/calibrated pattern, real cutting and sewing
Same motion protocol in real wear
Wearer comfort and mobility feedback plus observed garment behavior
Compare physical observations to numerical predictions

required_counterexamples.mutation: Keep total sleeve-cap/armhole length fixed but redistribute front/back length or move notches
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Local seam/notch mismatch; equal totals cannot yield seam-fit approval.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Sew front cap to back armhole, exchange left/right or rotate a non-axisymmetric sleeve
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Semantic pairing/orientation error even when counts and total lengths match.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Move/scale the actual body while preserving garment and old paths/landmarks
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Current body/path/landmark association or body/ease mismatch; source-body roundtrip must not dominate verdict.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Translate/rotate panels in2D atlas without altering edge lengths or co-moving grain basis
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Trajectory change indicates unwanted atlas-coordinate or stitch-rest-length dependence.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Scale only one sleeve material direction in rest key by0.9, keep initial3D geometry/body/settings fixed
required_counterexamples.must_detect: For edges parallel to the scaled direction, initial stretch ratio changes by1/0.9. For any edge use its exact new length sqrt(0.9^2*parallel_component^2+perpendicular_component^2); do not assign11.11% to diagonals. Actual solver response must differ beyond repeatability noise.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Rotate grain90degrees with geometry unchanged for a genuinely anisotropic calibrated material
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Material-orientation contract changes; isotropic simulation cannot claim the same physical behavior.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Provide a curved panel needing stretch, darts or additional cuts while output2D triangles stay nonoverlapping
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Metric distortion remains visible; zero UV overlap is not manufacturability.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Change upper-arm circumference or garment ease while retaining seam compatibility
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Fail the declared design-specific fit range, or UNKNOWN when no range is specified; no universal tight/loose judgment.

required_counterexamples.mutation: Use different spanning surfaces over the same nonplanar cuff boundary
required_counterexamples.must_detect: Unstable passage verdict is UNKNOWN, not select-the-passing-cap.

immediately_runnable_minimum: Asset object/dependency audits and source-array hash/remapping comparison
Four-panel coverage, disk topology,2D flip/overlap checks and distortion report
Segment-wise seam/notch arc-length table with explicit ease assumption
Left-sleeve0.9rest-metric perturbation with same3D initial state and fresh cache
Re-run strictv2 actual-mesh and body-association checks; retain existing FAIL/UNKNOWN results
Emit separate numerical-diagnostic, geometric-wearing, functional-fit and physical-fit status fields

sources.reviewed_scope: UV coordinates map mesh faces to2D images; workflow includes distortion inspection. This supports the distinction between UV mapping and metric-preserving pattern construction, not any4.3 API guarantee.
Measures weight, thickness, bending and stretch on warp, weft and bias swatches; material-direction and measured-response inputs are required for stronger fitting claims.
In-plane garment stress is not avatar contact pressure; Pressure Map is the relevant separate quantity.

observed_flatten_result.interpretation: Same source3D shared curve is flattened independently in bodice and sleeve. Difference is an introduced metric mismatch, not declared designer easing. Neither length equality nor mismatch establishes fit.

body_section_proxy_contract.inputs: A-pose actual body and garment meshes; planes normal to evaluated upper-arm bone axis at declared offsets such as0.12m and0.22m from shoulder bone point. Offsets define an experiment, not anatomy.
requirements: Intersection curves must be assembled from actual triangle-plane intersections with explicit contact/coplanarity tolerance
Report all loops and open polylines; do not close an open section artificially
Use simple closed loops containing the projected bone-axis point; centroid-nearest alone is insufficient
Multiple qualifying loops, branch points, tangency or missing enclosure produce UNKNOWN
Require the selected actual body section to lie inside the selected garment loop before reporting a positive clearance
Minimum unsigned boundary distance alone is not clearance; disjoint body and garment can be far apart
Record section area, perimeter, complete contour coordinates, containment, signed separation convention, frame and source hashes
Do not equate sleeve-cap arc length with biceps circumference; these are geometrically and anatomically different quantities
body_section_proxy_contract.claims_allowed: Local geometric section proxy at the tested pose, with measured numerical separation only.
body_section_proxy_contract.claims_disallowed: Anatomical armhole ground truth, complete shoulder/axilla clearance, comfort, or full-motion fit.
